overture.allowed_usage: Open data. Places: CDLA Permissive 2.0. Transportation/buildings: ODbL 1.0 (share-alike, attribution to OpenStreetMap contributors) and per-record `sources.license`. Verify before redistributing derived datasets.
overture.limits: No parcels. ~30-500 s per layer per bbox via DuckDB/S3 (measured). POI completeness varies by area; building footprints are not cadastral.

reliability.note: prior is a documented assumption; updated from observed runs

osm_overpass.allowed_usage: ODbL 1.0. Public Overpass instances have fair-use limits; use small bboxes and cache.
osm_overpass.limits: Public servers frequently return 429/5xx; the adapter uses bounded retries with backoff and falls back across mirrors.

reliability.note: observed unavailable during development testing on 2026-10-19

local_files.allowed_usage: User-supplied data; the user is responsible for licence compliance. Redistribution restrictions are copied into the manifest when declared in a sidecar .license file.
local_files.limits: Schema is inferred; columns lon/lat or geometry required.

suhail.authentication: none observed in the reference notebook; authorization status UNKNOWN
suhail.allowed_usage: UNESTABLISHED. The reference notebook calls undocumented tile and API endpoints in bulk. Disabled until the user records a licence/permission reference.
suhail.limits: Requires GEOACQUIRER_ENABLE_SUHAIL=1 and GEOACQUIRER_SUHAIL_AUTHORIZATION_REF. Honors rate limits and stops on 401/403/429 storms; no evasion.

geometry.parcel: Polygon (adapter preserves polygons; the original notebook kept centroids only)

urbi.authentication: API key required (env GEOACQUIRER_URBI_API_KEY). The key embedded in the reference notebook must NOT be reused: treat it as exposed and rotate it.
urbi.allowed_usage: UNESTABLISHED for bulk extraction. Use only under a licence from 2GIS/Urbi that permits storage and the intended use.
urbi.limits: Requires GEOACQUIRER_ENABLE_URBI=1, GEOACQUIRER_URBI_AUTHORIZATION_REF and GEOACQUIRER_URBI_API_KEY. Honest User-Agent; no header spoofing.
